images.title: Heights in two schools
images.purpose: Show the twelve dot plots of heights of boys and girls of Grades 6, 7 and 8 in two schools, each with its mean line.
images.composition: Two columns of six small dot plots, School A on the left and School B on the right, with Grade 6, 7 and 8 pairs separated by thin rules.
exact_structure: Every small plot has a number line from 120 to 170 cm with numbered ticks at 120, 130, 140, 150, 160 and 170, a solid vertical mean line and its mean printed to its right.
Boys' plots use teal (#0072B2) dots, girls' plots use amber (#E69F00) dots; each plot has between 10 and 16 dots, stacked where values repeat.
School A, Grade 6 boys: dots from about 126 to 146 cm, mean line at 134.8.
School A, Grade 6 girls: dots from about 120 to 154 cm, mean line at 137.78.
School A, Grade 7 boys: dots from about 128 to 158 cm, mean line at 141.8.
School A, Grade 7 girls: dots from about 130 to 156 cm, mean line at 141.83.
School A, Grade 8 boys: dots from about 140 to 162 cm, mean line at 149.35.
School A, Grade 8 girls: dots from about 140 to 158 cm, mean line at 147.81.
School B, Grade 6 boys: dots from about 140 to 158 cm, mean line at 149.84.
School B, Grade 6 girls: dots from about 134 to 162 cm, mean line at 150.2.
School B, Grade 7 boys: dots from about 140 to 168 cm, mean line at 156.14.
School B, Grade 7 girls: dots from about 144 to 168 cm, mean line at 155.41.
School B, Grade 8 boys: dots from about 140 to 168 cm, mean line at 156.14.
School B, Grade 8 girls: dots from about 144 to 168 cm, mean line at 156.83.
A heading School A over the left column and School B over the right column.
rejection: a mean line placed away from its printed value
the grades in a different order
boys and girls in the same colour
images.takeaway: In the same grade, School B's students are taller on average than School A's, and boys and girls swap places from grade to grade.
images.description: Twelve dot plots of heights of boys and girls in Grades 6, 7 and 8 in two schools, each with its mean.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: School B's Grade 7 and Grade 8 boys both print a mean of 156.14; treat it as the given value and do not read meaning into the repeat.

image_decisions.why: The comparison of schools and grades is read from twelve dot plots.
